partner_result.application: Used the final physical star scale h, tau0=h^2/128 and N3 coefficient cap, together with the inherited a/h floor, to turn coheavy residual E3 into universal continuous/pair payments or dimension-free aggregate bank lower bounds.

new_claims.statement: If an original-coordinate cross block N has row and column natural third-volume marginals both >2/3 at anchors u,v, then its anchored third-minor mass G3 exceeds E3(N)/3 and, for N=[[b,r^T],[c,H]], sqrt(G3)<=|b|sqrt(E2(H))+||c||||r||||H||F.
A star-star-Frobenius product CRF splits into a four-disjoint-bank packet >CRF/(4sqrt2), or a physical row/column hub edge-star-star packet >CRF/(8sqrt7).

The r30 residual E3(N)>(8/3)a^6 branch routes to a continuous full-output payment <17.992/a, an essentially bounded physical-pair payment <6.800e12, a huge-E2 four-bank matching B1B2>1.076074733e6 a^2, a four-bank star/core packet >a^3/12, or a punctured-hub two-star packet >2.033590097e5 a^2.

next_step: Consume the pre-existing r30 six-bank packet and the new E2/star-core/punctured-hub packets through a curvature-safe full-ambient receiver; do not replace tiny nonzero curvature by zero.
